Package com.example.space.essentials

Class Simulation

java.lang.Object
com.example.space.essentials.Simulation
public class Simulation extends Object
Represents the physics simulation of bodies under gravity.

This class manages a collection of Body instances and updates their states using the Runge-Kutta 4th-order integration method.
